title: Keeping a dream journal showed me that I don't actually have recurring dreams, but they feel like it
content: I have occasionally had these dreams where, during the dream, I'm sure that it's happened before and that I've had this dream or a similar one again and again. Then I wake up and consult my dream journal and confirm that this was never true, that I don't have recurring dreams, no matter how strongly it feels like I do during the dream. Feeling that a dream is recurring is just part of the dream. Has anyone else experienced that?
